scope: Positions 1 through 500 in the current 2026 Fortune ranking, revisited for entity resolution and AMACS taxonomy-depth testing rather than repeated primary-industry triage.

regulatory_metadata_mirror.provenance_note: The mirror is a third-party transformation of the SEC nightly submissions archive and is identified as such in every generated record.

boundaries: The Fortune position establishes cohort membership only; it does not prove any AMACS capability.
Regulatory entity matching resolves a likely reporting entity and metadata source, not a production organization profile.
The pinned Datamule files are an SEC-derived mirror, not an SEC-hosted source, and the source chain must remain visible.
Private, mutual, cooperative, governmental, foreign, and otherwise unresolved organizations remain in the analyst review queue rather than being forced to a public-company match.
Primary-activity and SIC-description mappings remain taxonomy observations marked not_for_profile_import.
Annual filing text and operating-segment review remains a governed follow-on evidence layer and must not be inferred from the SIC description.
